description: Compose a new email. Default mode is 'draft' (saved to Drafts folder, not sent). Use mode='send' to send immediately, mode='open' to open in Thunderbird's compose window for human review. ALWAYS prefer draft mode unless the human explicitly asked to send.

attachments.description: File NAMES (not paths) from the user's attachments folder (TB_ATTACH_DIR, default ~/thunderbird-cli-attachments). Use email_attachments operation 'available' to see them. Only files the user placed there can be attached; never ask for other paths.

from.description: Sender: an identity's email address (e.g. me@example.org) or its identity ID. email_stats lists each account's identities (id, email, name).

mode.description: draft (default, saves silently), open (compose window for the user), send (only if the user allowed direct sending in the add-on options; otherwise SEND_DISABLED, then save a draft instead)

name: email_compose
